summary: The Decathalon datalist loader is implemented, but I have not run any tests, black, or flake8 because the instructions prohibited running repository code. What was done: added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper (standard library only); added an explicit import in monai/data/__init__.py; added a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule; and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing four tests. Line lengths were measured and no line exceeds 120 columns. Nothing was committed. Open items: the tests and style gates have not been executed, and the loader does not check that the entries under data_list_key are a list, so a non-list value gives a less clear error than a ValueError would.
